Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jasper Phillips wrote:
>
> I've played so many damn games I can't quite keep all the rules straight,
> and have one that's been nagging me. If you target an action against
> a minion, can that minion intercept? (Or is it Shadowfist where you
> can't?)

A directed action can be blocked by any of the ready untapped
minions controlled by the target Methuselah.

In the case of a directed action which targets a minion, this
includes the minion, if he is ready and untapped.
